title: Wormhole Reconstruction in Non-Conservative Unimodular Gravity: Ricci Scalar as an Independently Prescribed Curvature Profile
summary: The absence of an algebraic relation between the Ricci scalar and the trace of the energy-momentum tensor in Non-Conservative Unimodular Gravity ($\mathrm{NUG}$) opens new possibilities for constructing spacetime geometries from prescribed curvature profiles. Exploiting this property, we develop a curvature reconstruction framework in which traversable wormhole geometries are generated directly from a prescribed curvature profile rather than from the matter sector or the metric functions.
